en.label: Identity
en.definition: Your values, roles and self-description.

en.label: Expression
en.definition: How you communicate and express your views.

en.label: Relationships
en.definition: Connections you have chosen to describe.

en.label: Environment
en.definition: Your stated living and working conditions.

en.label: Growth
en.definition: Learning, experience and progress over time.

en.label: Possibilities
en.definition: Options within your resources and constraints.

zh.label: 身份
zh.definition: 你的价值、角色与自我认识。

zh.label: 表达
zh.definition: 你如何沟通和表达观点。

zh.label: 关系
zh.definition: 你选择说明的人际连接。

zh.label: 环境
zh.definition: 你明确提供的生活与工作条件。

zh.label: 成长
zh.definition: 随时间积累的学习、经验与进展。

zh.label: 可能性
zh.definition: 在资源与限制下可以探索的选择。

en.label: Identity
en.definition: The household and responsibilities within its stated scope.

en.label: Expression
en.definition: How members communicate and make shared decisions.

en.label: Relationships
en.definition: Consented care and support connections; not private member reports.

en.label: Environment
en.definition: Housing, services and shared living conditions.

en.label: Growth
en.definition: Lifecycle changes and adaptation of shared resources.

en.label: Possibilities
en.definition: Options that members can choose together.

zh.label: 身份
zh.definition: 已明确范围内的家庭组成与责任。

zh.label: 表达
zh.definition: 成员如何沟通及作共同决定。

zh.label: 关系
zh.definition: 经授权的照护与支持连接，不包含成员私人报告。

zh.label: 环境
zh.definition: 住房、公共服务与共同生活条件。

zh.label: 成长
zh.definition: 家庭阶段变化与共同资源的适应。

zh.label: 可能性
zh.definition: 可由成员共同选择的路径。

en.label: Identity
en.definition: A team’s stated purpose, roles and mandate.

en.label: Expression
en.definition: Coordination, communication and work practices.

en.label: Relationships
en.definition: Task dependencies and agreed collaboration.

en.label: Environment
en.definition: Resources, working conditions and project constraints.

en.label: Growth
en.definition: Evidence of learning, capability and delivery changes.

en.label: Possibilities
en.definition: Feasible improvements requiring team agreement.

zh.label: 身份
zh.definition: 团队明确的目标、角色与职责。

zh.label: 表达
zh.definition: 协调、沟通及工作方式。

zh.label: 关系
zh.definition: 任务依赖与已约定的协作。

zh.label: 环境
zh.definition: 资源、工作环境与项目限制。

zh.label: 成长
zh.definition: 学习、能力及交付变化的证据。

zh.label: 可能性
zh.definition: 需要团队同意的可行改进。

en.label: Identity
en.definition: Business activities, operating boundary and declared legal form.

en.label: Expression
en.definition: Products, services and how the business reaches customers.

en.label: Relationships
en.definition: Authorized supplier, customer and operating dependencies.

en.label: Environment
en.definition: Market, costs, supply chain and relevant public conditions.

en.label: Growth
en.definition: Changes in comparable operating and financial evidence.

en.label: Possibilities
en.definition: Operating options subject to cash, capacity and uncertainty.

zh.label: 身份
zh.definition: 业务活动、经营范围及声明的法律形式。

zh.label: 表达
zh.definition: 产品、服务及面向客户的经营方式。

zh.label: 关系
zh.definition: 获授权的供应商、客户与经营依赖。

zh.label: 环境
zh.definition: 市场、成本、供应链及相关公共条件。

zh.label: 成长
zh.definition: 可比的经营与财务证据所显示的变化。

zh.label: 可能性
zh.definition: 受现金、能力及不确定性约束的经营选择。

en.label: Identity
en.definition: An institution’s mission, mandate and service scope.

en.label: Expression
en.definition: How services and governance are delivered.

en.label: Relationships
en.definition: Stakeholders and authorized institutional responsibilities.

en.label: Environment
en.definition: Policy, funding and operating conditions.

en.label: Growth
en.definition: Changes in service coverage and organizational capability.

en.label: Possibilities
en.definition: Options consistent with the mandate and restricted funding.

zh.label: 身份
zh.definition: 机构的宗旨、职责与服务范围。

zh.label: 表达
zh.definition: 服务及治理如何运作。

zh.label: 关系
zh.definition: 利益相关方及获授权的机构责任。

zh.label: 环境
zh.definition: 政策、资金与运营条件。

zh.label: 成长
zh.definition: 服务覆盖与组织能力的变化。

zh.label: 可能性
zh.definition: 符合职责及受限资金条件的可选路径。

en.label: Identity
en.definition: The public geographic entity and the scope of observation.

en.label: Expression
en.definition: Publicly documented institutions and economic activities.

en.label: Relationships
en.definition: Public trade and institutional connections, not personal relationships.

en.label: Environment
en.definition: Dated economic, social and infrastructure observations.

en.label: Growth
en.definition: Comparable changes over time, with revisions retained.

en.label: Possibilities
en.definition: Public-policy scenarios and trade-offs, not predictions.

zh.label: 身份
zh.definition: 公共地理主体及观察范围。

zh.label: 表达
zh.definition: 有公共资料支持的制度与经济活动。

zh.label: 关系
zh.definition: 公开贸易与制度连接，而非个人人际关系。

zh.label: 环境
zh.definition: 带有观察日期的经济、社会与基础设施资料。

zh.label: 成长
zh.definition: 可比的时间变化，并保留修订身份。

zh.label: 可能性
zh.definition: 公共政策情景与权衡，而非确定预测。
